current_state: This record covers the 2026-10-03 to 2026-10-06 successful verify-or-sync runs through the PR #31 merge (checkpoint #28). Every recorded checkpoint is status=MATCH with identical primary and secondary trees; 20 carried a replication write (rollback_commit present). A run that finds snapshots already equal is an idempotent no-op, not a failure. The correctly BLOCKED run (#11) is documented separately and is excluded from MATCH counts. Three windows in which verify-or-sync did not execute at all are recorded in section 5e and are NOT checkpoints: no match, no mismatch and no write was observed for them. Window B (PR #26 tip, 13 runs) was closed by checkpoint #21; window C (PR #29 tip) remains a documented gap. All 28 rows were re-read live on 2026-10-06 with zero mismatches.
